new_cross_view_blocker.origin: Owner finding relayed by root after the independent single-owner review
new_cross_view_blocker.mechanism: Optional prefix Pages held by renderer A consume the shared base/mandatory NativeCanvas Page budget. Renderer B can trim only its own prefix cache, so mandatory allocations may fail even when the corresponding baseline renderers fit without A optional cache.
new_cross_view_blocker.required_resolution: Optional cache admission/ownership must not prevent other renderers from using otherwise sufficient mandatory canvas capacity; cross-view failure and recovery need validation.
new_cross_view_blocker.timebox_policy: Root requested short timebox; defer CPU prefix cache if not resolved and validated.
new_cross_view_blocker.resolution: Global atomic RAII optional-prefix byte admission plus independent prefix Page pool; output allocates Page(base.budget_) and copies only Surface. Local PrefixState shared ownership outlives Page aliases during failure/cold restart.

final_separate_pool_review.held_owner_lifetime_review: PrefixOwner declared before terrainPage and initialPage; PrefixState charge declared before Entry so charge credit returns after owned buffers; verified in final source.
final_separate_pool_review.allocation_failure_review: State allocation precedes atomic charge in constructor; failed optional insert/planning/build cleanup releases states; no output Page copies inherit optional Page budget.
